user.title: Lanka Electricity Company (LECO)
user.description: Enter your 10-digit LECO Electricity Account Number (starting with 01 to 07) to track your bill balance and connection status.

data_description.kwh_entity: Entity providing electricity consumption in kWh (e.g. utility meter or energy sensor) for bill calculation.
data_description.billing_day: Day of the month your LECO meter is read and your billing cycle resets (1 - 31).
data_description.is_cumulative: Enable if the selected kWh entity accumulates total lifetime energy (e.g. solar inverter grid import). Current cycle consumption is calculated starting from your billing day using Home Assistant statistics. Disable if the entity already resets each cycle (e.g. monthly utility meter) or is a manual input.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to LECO InstantPay portal. Please verify internet connection or check if portal is reachable.
error.invalid_account_number: Invalid account number. LECO electricity account numbers must be 10 digits starting with 01 to 07.

abort.already_configured: This LECO account is already configured.

init.description: Configure polling interval, consumption entity, and billing cycle date.
